dialog.onchain.body: SatSage reconstructs from the blockchain when sats reached or left these wallet addresses. That is an on-chain record, not a complete proof of acquisition. It does not replace exchange histories, purchase receipts, bank statements, or similar documents — it can only complement them. Whether a cut-off date or holding period applies is not decided by this program.
dialog.onchain.okTitle: Confirms the notice. With the box checked it will not appear again on this installation.
dialog.onchain.title: Note on the on-chain record
dialog.privacy.body: Only connections without privacy are available. Connect your own node, or analyze only toy xpubs to try things out and refresh the Electrum server list via Setup.
dialog.privacy.okTitle: Saves anyway. Public servers will then see the derived addresses.
dialog.privacy.removeTitle: Discards the XPUB just entered. Nothing is saved. Default action (Enter/Escape).
dialog.privacy.title: No private connection
dialog.p2pPrivacy.body: P2P compact filters are connected. Public Electrum servers (onion/clearnet) may still see addresses as a fallback. Cut public connections? Scans may then be slower if P2P fails.
dialog.p2pPrivacy.noTitle: Public servers stay allowed as emergency fallback.
dialog.p2pPrivacy.title: Higher privacy?
dialog.p2pPrivacy.yesTitle: Stop public Electrum use. Only your node and P2P remain.
dialog.publicElectrum.body: Compact filters (BIP-158) found no peers. Public Electrum servers (onion or clearnet) see the derived wallet addresses. Connect anyway?
dialog.publicElectrum.noTitle: Stays with your own node and BIP-158. No public servers are queried.
dialog.publicElectrum.title: Public Electrum servers?
dialog.publicElectrum.yesTitle: Allows public Electrum servers. Addresses go to third parties.
dialog.scanDate.body: No age is known for this wallet, and the cache is empty. BIP-158 walks the chain only from the chosen day — earlier outputs stay invisible.
dialog.scanDate.fieldTitle: Blocks before this day are not searched. SegWit: 2017-08-24. Earlier = more complete and slower.
dialog.scanDate.hintGenesis: Suggestion: 2009-01-03 (Genesis). Earlier than needed only makes the scan longer.
dialog.scanDate.hintSegwit: Suggestion: 2017-08-24 (SegWit activation). Native SegWit did not exist before.
dialog.scanDate.label: Not before
dialog.scanDate.title: Scan from when?
dialog.setup.continueTitle: Opens wallets or data sources — whichever is still missing.
dialog.setup.intro1: SatSage reads your wallets via their public keys — it never sees private keys and cannot spend. Three things need to be set up before analysis can show anything.
dialog.setup.intro2: The first compact-filter scan of the first XPUB must load block headers from SegWit (August 2017). That is one-time: afterwards they stay local for all wallets. The download already runs in the background — you can leave the server running without a wallet until headers are ready. Your own Electrum server (electrs or Fulcrum) on the LAN skips this step; Electrs on the LAN is typically the fastest path for the UTXO set.
dialog.setup.laterTitle: Closes this notice. You can open it anytime via Setup under Settings.
dialog.setup.title: Initial setup
dialog.setup.written: Everything is written to .env and stays on this machine.
dialog.token.body: This UI requires the session token printed when the server started. Open the full address from the console — it already includes the token.
dialog.token.title: Token missing
dialog.walletScan.body: A UTXO scan fetches the current set. A history scan also captures spent amounts (e.g. for the tax year) and takes longer.
dialog.walletScan.hint: During a scan you may close the browser — server and job keep running in the terminal.

dock.helpText:
Allowed commands — local cache only, no scans:
/help — this list
/anbindung — provider, target, model, tier
/neu — clear conversation
/luecken — what is missing and which buttons fill it
/wallets — names and cache status
/steuer [year] — figures if the cache suffices
/export legende|markdown|brief [year] — text from cache, not a CSV substitute
Free text: local model or remote after opt-in. Numbers only from cache.
Blocked: /scan, /exec and similar. Scans only via the buttons.

sanctions.discardTitle: Deletes the stored check result. The lists themselves remain.
sanctions.heading: Sanctions check
sanctions.hintFallible: Lists contain errors and go stale.
sanctions.hintMultiList: The count per source counts that source's addresses. The same address can appear on several lists — so the sum can exceed the total.
sanctions.meta: Checks the external history of your UTXOs against sanctions and blacklists — up to the chosen hop depth.
sanctions.noListsHint: Nothing downloaded yet. Without lists the check finds nothing — that is not a clean bill of health.
sanctions.note1: A hit does not mean your coins are “banned” — only that an address in the history is on a list. With many hops the number of checked addresses grows fast; the run then takes longer.
sanctions.note2: The result stays stored locally and is shown again when opening this view — as of when it was produced. It ages: lists change, and new UTXOs are not covered. After wallet changes, re-check or discard.
sanctions.selfCheckHint: This checks whether an address itself is listed. Whether the sats came from a listed source is answered only by the origin analysis.
sanctions.startTitle: Checks the history of holdings against sanctions and blacklists — up to the set hop depth. Can take minutes depending on depth.
settings.deadlines.acquisitionTitle: Defensive: youngest external inflow (manual 4.3). Offensive: oldest — longer holding period, riskier. Never a silent default.
settings.deadlines.applyTitle: Writes cut-off, holding period, and acquisition reading into .env. Tax year then uses them.
settings.deadlines.cutoffTitle: Empty: holding period applies to all acquisitions. Set date: acquisitions afterwards do not become tax-free by holding (Austrian new assets, 2021-02-28).
settings.deadlines.hint: Holding period prefilled with 1 year (Germany, § 23 EStG). Cut-off empty: the period applies to all acquisitions. Acquisition from origin: default defensive (youngest external inflow). Offensive uses the oldest inflow and can show a longer holding period — especially risky with an incomplete origin tree. Known private holding periods in Europe (as of 2026 — not tax advice): Germany 1 year, Portugal 1 year, Czechia 3 years, Luxembourg 6 months. Switzerland: private disposal gains usually tax-free without a period. Austria: after the 2022 reform, no tax-free status by holding. Known cut-off: Austria 2021-02-28 (BMF, legacy) — acquisitions afterwards (new assets) do not become tax-free by holding. Other European countries have no comparable cut-off.
settings.deadlines.holdingTitle: Default 1 year (Germany, § 23 EStG). Other countries: Czechia 3 years, Luxembourg 6 months, Portugal 1 year.
settings.deadlines.title: Deadlines and cut-off
settings.deadlines.zusatz: Holding period for tax-free status; optional cut-off like Austrian legacy holdings

settings.start.hint: With your Electrs: address subscribe and targeted listunspent; new blocks → light tip catch-up. Without own Electrs only catch-up at start. No full scan.
settings.start.syncTitle: When on: tip catch-up at start, then continuous watch via your Electrs (address subscribe). New txs on known addresses and light tip updates on new blocks — no full scan. Needs your own Electrs/Fulcrum; without it only start catch-up. Wallets without a cache stay untouched.
settings.start.title: Freshness
settings.startSyncOff: Not keeping wallets continuously up to date.
settings.startSyncOn: Keeping wallets up to date — Electrs watch + tip catch-up (running now).
settings.startSyncStarted: Tip catch-up started — wallets are updating now.

setup.step.bip158Text: First the node on the LAN (P2P port 8333), then extra peers, then DNS seeds. Without compact filters on your own node, other filter peers are searched — not immediately public Electrum servers. Addresses stay local.
setup.step.coreText: UTXO set via scantxoutset on your own bitcoind (LAN before onion). Electrs on the LAN takes priority — gap scan is often faster. No history and no origin from Core; those stay with Electrum or BIP-158.
setup.step.electrumText: Fulcrum, electrs, or ElectrumX on your own network. Without it, queries run via compact filters or third-party servers. Your own Electrum server skips the one-time block-header download and speeds up the first scan.
setup.step.explorerText: Your own mempool.space instance. Opens every UTXO and address in the explorer with one click. Without an entry, outbound links are deliberately omitted.
setup.step.walletsText: Public keys (xpub, ypub, zpub, vpub) or — for multisig — the wallet descriptor. Addresses are derived from that.

sources.heading: Data sources
sources.importEurTitle: Choose a CSV with BTC/EUR daily rates. Written into the local rate cache.
sources.importUsdTitle: Choose a CSV with BTC/USD daily rates. Written into the local rate cache.
sources.labelsImportTitle: Import locally obtained files: entity-filter.bin, entity-index.bin, entities.json (or *-full.bin), or a ZIP. When download fails.
sources.labelsLoadTitle: Downloads the label set once. Afterwards every address is looked up only locally — no outbound request.
sources.labelsRemoveTitle: Deletes the downloaded set again. Origin addresses then appear without a label.
sources.labelsScopeTitle: Core set: about 1.7 MB, almost every address named. Full set: 37 MB, knows far more addresses but names only a few.
sources.listsImportTitle: Import locally obtained lists: JSON address list, TXT (one address per line), SDN XML, or ZIP. When online download fails.
sources.listsUpdateTitle: Re-downloads sanctions and blacklists (OFAC, OpenSanctions, and others). The first run transfers about 125 MB.
sources.loadElectrumTitle: Fetches the Electrum server list from {url}
sources.mempool.local: Reachable only on your network — requests stay with you.
sources.mempool.publicKnown: Known public service: every link tells it which transaction or address you open.
sources.mempool.publicOther: Publicly reachable address. If that is your own instance, fine — otherwise this server learns what you view.
sources.mempoolSaveTitle: Saves the address of your own mempool.space instance. Without an entry, no outbound links appear.
sources.metaHtml: Changes are written to .env. Comments and other entries are kept.
sources.note.bip158: First the node on the LAN (P2P port 8333), then extra peers, then DNS seeds. Without compact filters on your own node, other filter peers are searched — not immediately public Electrum servers. Addresses stay local.
sources.note.bip158.empty: P2P is off. If onion or clearnet lists are loaded and public Electrum is allowed, they take over.
sources.note.clearnet: Only after confirmation — addresses go to third parties.
sources.note.clearnet.empty: No list yet — “Load from Electrum” fetches it.
sources.note.own_core: UTXO set via scantxoutset on your own bitcoind (LAN before onion). Electrs on the LAN takes priority — gap scan is often faster. No history and no origin from Core; those stay with Electrum or BIP-158.
sources.note.own_core.empty: UTXO set via scantxoutset: host (LAN or .onion), port, RPC user and password. Ideal with -txindex=1. Electrs on the LAN stays faster and has priority.
sources.note.own_fulcrum.empty: Enter host — Fulcrum, electrs, or ElectrumX
sources.note.public_onion: Rotation mitigates the risk of individual servers. Only after confirmation.
sources.ratesHintHtml: Bundled: Bitstamp closing rates (CryptoDataDownload). Your own CSV (Bloomberg etc.) with date and price columns overwrites matching days in the cache. Format e.g. date,price or semicolon; header row is detected. Daily gap backfill (Bitstamp) only with opt-in.
sources.ratesOptInTitle: Allows one CryptoDataDownload Bitstamp daily-rate fetch per day when the local series lags behind yesterday. 4-week overlap; large discrepancies are logged.
sources.ratesSyncTitle: Check gaps now and, with opt-in, download the Bitstamp CSV.
sources.ratesZusatz: Daily EUR/USD history locally — network only for missing days and spot
sources.rotationNote: Rotation mitigates the risk of individual servers. Only after confirmation.
sources.start9BridgeHint: Start9 supplies Electrs and Core RPC; these two sources are managed by Start9.
sources.testNodeTitle: Tests your Electrum server (Fulcrum/electrs). If reachable on the LAN, Tor is not started. Only connects — no address is queried.
state.unreadableToken: State unreadable, token missing or invalid
tax.cancelTitle: Cancels the run. Origin already computed is kept.
tax.csvTitle: Listing as CSV for spreadsheets and tax advisors — semicolon and decimal comma so Excel reads it without rework. Format stays DE-conventional regardless of UI language.
tax.depositTitle: If set: this tx is selected and its inputs from your wallets are shown.
tax.heading: Tax year
tax.historyAllTitle: Fetches history of all wallets — including spent amounts. Single wallet: history scan in the wallet view. Same cache. Needs an Electrum server.
tax.holdingTitle: Years until tax-free. Default 1 year (Germany). Multi-year periods in the dropdown.
tax.loadCandidatesTitle: Loads tax-year outflows and open UTXOs as what-if.
tax.refreshCandidatesTitle: Reload from cache — e.g. after a history scan or with a deposit TxID filter. Happens automatically when opening this view.
tax.meta: UTXOs by holding period. Not tax advice — verify the figures yourself before use.
tax.metaHtml: History scan (wallet) or History of all wallets fetches which amounts ever existed, including long-spent ones — only then do disposals become visible. Origin of all UTXOs clarifies where the sats came from and supplies the acquisition date. A complete listing needs both.
tax.originAllTitle: For every still-open UTXO, walks backwards where the sats came from. Supplies this wallet's on-chain acquisition date — without it only the output's creation date applies, which is too young for change and self-transfers. Exchange purchase and holding outside the chain are not shown here.
tax.reportCsvTitle: Same data as CSV for Excel (master data on top, full TxIDs/addresses).
tax.reportHtmlTitle: Opens the HTML report in a new tab (print → PDF) and also saves the file.
tax.reportTitle: Printable report as a standalone HTML file. Open in the browser and use “Print → Save as PDF”.
tax.selfReportHint: For late filing / voluntary disclosure: outflows and what-if UTXOs load from cache when you open this view — mark them (e.g. exchange deposit) and build the report. Person data are placeholders for now (Donald Duck / 0/8/15 / Duckburg). Not tax advice.
trace.allOriginsTitle: For every still-open UTXO, walks backwards where the sats came from — the same analysis as in Tax year. Once computed, it stays stored.
trace.allOriginsNeedUtxo: No UTXO balance yet — run a UTXO scan (wallet) first, then origin of all UTXOs.
trace.allOriginsNeedUtxoConfirm:
No UTXO balance in the cache yet.

Really scan the UTXO balance for all wallets and then trace the origin of all UTXOs?

This can take a very long time (balance + origin). Cancel starts nothing.
trace.allOriginsNothing: Origin analysis is already available for all UTXOs.
trace.arrivalTitle: Shows the stored origin, or computes it once.
trace.cancelTitle: Cancels the run. Origin already computed is kept.
trace.cancelled: Cancelled. Expanding again restarts the analysis.
trace.coinbaseNote: Freshly mined sats — every origin ends here.
trace.externalNotFollowed: External branches are not followed further.
trace.folgeBundledConfirm: Resolve bundled inputs? On large batch txs all inputs are resolved — this can take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeBundledHint: Inputs bundled — acquisition date may be newer than shown (lower bound).
trace.folgeBundledTitle: On large batch txs, resolves all own inputs (opt-in beyond the 20-input limit).
trace.folgeDoneHint: Origin gaps were followed up. “Rescan” resets the state.
trace.folgeDoneTitle: Remaining own inputs of large batch txs and predecessor txs were already followed up. “Rescan” resets the state.
trace.folgeLueckenConfirm: Close origin gaps? Loads remaining own inputs of large batch txs and follows own predecessor txs further — can take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeLueckenHint: Branched or bundled inputs: optionally follow up fully. Otherwise the acquisition date is only a lower bound. Detected coinjoin/mix follows only own inputs — peers are noise.
trace.folgeLueckenTitle: Loads remaining own inputs of large batch txs (e.g. consolidation) and follows own predecessor txs further. CoinJoin already uses own-only. Can take a while. Cancel in the dialog starts nothing.
trace.folgeSuggestHint: Branched origin — predecessor txs can be analyzed further.
trace.folgeTxConfirm: Analyze predecessors more thoroughly? This can cost many fetches and take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeTxTitle: Walks each already found own predecessor transaction and follows its inflows further.
trace.followedCached: Origin is stored — expanding shows it immediately.
trace.followedStale: Known wallet addresses changed since this trace — “Rescan” refreshes the tree.
trace.heading: Trace origin
trace.meta: Walks backwards where an output's sats came from — until an external address or a coinbase.
trace.missingTitle: “youngest sats” only covers UTXOs of this address that are already fully traced. The others may still show younger inflows after a full trace.
trace.coinjoinOwnOnlyEmpty: Only own coinjoin inputs are followed — no further own predecessors found here.
trace.noteCoinbase: Freshly mined sats — every origin ends here.
trace.noteExternalNotFollowed: External branches are not followed further.
trace.noteUnresolvedInputs: {count} further inputs were not resolved — after the first own input the resolution stops to avoid hundreds of lookups on consolidation transactions. Amounts of these inputs are missing.
trace.receivePendingTitle: Unconfirmed receive in the mempool (own Electrs) — typically change or a self-transfer.
trace.rescanTitle: Discards the stored origin tree and retraces only this UTXO — through all your XPUBs to the first external address.
trace.sinceAnalysisAdded: Since this trace SatSage knows {count} more wallet address(es) (e.g. after a deeper scan) — some branches might now count as internal. “Rescan” at the top of the UTXO refreshes the tree.
trace.sinceAnalysisChanged: The set of known wallet addresses changed since this trace (e.g. after a scan or a new xpub) — some branches might be classified differently now. “Rescan” at the top of the UTXO refreshes the tree.
trace.spendingPendingTitle: Unconfirmed spend in the mempool (own Electrs). UTXO stays in the balance until confirmation.
trace.spentPendingTitle: Unconfirmed spend in the mempool — seen on your Electrs. Not in a block yet.
trace.spentTitle: This output is no longer in the balance.
trace.startTitle: Traces a single output. Enter as txid:vout or as a bare TxID (then output 0).
trace.unresolvedInputsNote: {count} further inputs were not resolved — after the first own input the resolution stops to avoid hundreds of lookups on consolidation transactions. Amounts of these inputs are missing.
trace.youngestSatsTitle: All sats are traced back to an external address. The date is the youngest inflow from outside.
wallet.emptyNoCache: No cache yet for this wallet.
wallet.emptyNoCacheHint: A UTXO scan queries addresses at the configured data source and builds the cache.
wallet.emptyNoUtxoHint: The wallet was scanned but has no balance. Is the script type correct? Wallets without SLIP-132 always export “xpub”.
wallet.fresh.behindTitle: Cache behind chain tip — use “To tip” (incremental) or UTXO scan (full).
wallet.fresh.noneTitle: No UTXO scan yet — list is not from the network.
wallet.fresh.oldTitle: Cache older than a day — use “To tip” or UTXO scan.
wallet.fresh.syncingTitle: Cache is catching up to chain tip (incremental, not a full scan).
wallet.fresh.unknownTitle: UTXO cache present but without a timestamp.
wallet.historyScanTitle: Fetches this wallet's full history — including long-spent amounts. Writes the same cache that Tax year and “Already spent” read. Needs an Electrum server. Origin/acquisition date is a separate step.
wallet.noScanSpentBelow: No UTXO scan yet. Spent amounts from history are listed below.
wallet.noSpendsHint: No unspent UTXOs — spent amounts are listed below if collected.
wallet.noSpendsYet: No spends from these wallets yet.
wallet.originDeepCancelTitle: Cancels. Already finished origin trees stay in cache.
wallet.originDeepConfirm:
Full origin for “{name}”?

Every UTXO is run like “Close origin gaps” (batch inputs + predecessors) to red (external) or purple (coinbase) — may take hours. Cancel in the dialog starts nothing; cancel while running keeps already finished trees in cache.

Useful first: UTXO scan (balance set).
wallet.originDeepNeedCache: No UTXO cache — run UTXO scan first.
wallet.originDeepNothing: All UTXOs of this wallet are already fully traced.
wallet.originDeepTitle: Traces every UTXO of this wallet like “Close origin gaps”: large batch txs and own predecessor txs through to an external address or coinbase. Can take a very long time (overnight is fine). Afterwards everything sits in cache. Needs a UTXO set.
wallet.scanCancelTitle: Cancels only the running scan. Queued scans continue afterwards.
wallet.sortTitle: Size: largest amount first. Date: newest movement first (for spent outputs, the spend).
wallet.spentSectionTitle: Spent outputs — section stays collapsed, content is cached. Total volume = sum of face values of all spent outputs (not a net balance). Pending = unconfirmed in mempool (own node).
wallet.tipSyncNeedCache: No UTXO cache — run UTXO scan first.
wallet.tipSyncTitle: Catch existing cache up to chain tip (BIP-158 incremental or Electrs light). Not a full scan from index 0 — use UTXO scan for that.
wallet.utxoScanTitle: Re-queries this wallet's addresses at the node and refreshes the UTXO set. Needed after new transactions. Spent amounts are not included — the history scan next to it fetches those.
wallets.addTitle: Writes the wallet into .env immediately. Name is optional and later changeable via Update.
wallets.cacheClearAllTitle: Deletes UTXO, history, and origin cache of all wallets. Wallet age and block headers remain. Then scan again — BIP-158 from first-seen.
wallets.cacheClearReallyTitle: Delete permanently. The set is then gone.
wallets.cacheDeleteTitle: Deletes UTXO set, history, and origin for this wallet only. Then scan again.
wallets.confirmRemove:
Remove “{name}” from .env?
Afterwards the UI asks about the analysis cache.
wallets.dangerText: Deletes the analysis cache: UTXO set, history, and origin trees. Per wallet or all at once. Wallet age (first-seen), block headers, sanctions lists, and address labels remain — the next BIP-158 scan starts at the known wallet beginning, not again at SegWit. Not undoable.
wallets.descriptorHint: Check the address first, then apply — saves immediately.
wallets.descriptorHintTitle: A multisig descriptor can look correct even if a cosigner is swapped. That is why the first receive address is shown — compare it with the wallet. Apply writes it into .env immediately.
wallets.descriptorNameTitle: Display name. Empty = placeholder. Changeable in the row after applying.
wallets.descriptorPlaceholder: wsh(sortedmulti(2,…)) or tr(…,multi_a(2,…)) — also JSON export from Sparrow, Specter, or Bitcoin Core
wallets.emptyList: No wallet registered yet. Enter name and XPUB below, then “Add”.
wallets.heading: Wallets
wallets.importTitle: Reads an export file and checks it like pasted text. Understood: bare output descriptor (also with checksum), Sparrow JSON, Specter JSON, and Bitcoin Core listdescriptors — receive and change are merged. Taproot multi_a and Miniscript when addresses can be derived. Not: Electrum wallet file, Caravan, Coldcard cosigner, BSMS, UR/BBQr, or anything with private keys.
wallets.metaHtml: Changes are written to .env. Comments and other entries are kept.
wallets.nameTitle: Display name in the list. Empty = placeholder from the key. Later changeable in the row via Update.
wallets.probeTitle: Derives addresses for each script type and asks the node which were ever used. Clarifies which type really belongs to this XPUB — with an “xpub” prefix that cannot be read off.
wallets.rowUpdateTitle: Writes this wallet's name, script type, and scan depth into .env.
wallets.unrefDeleteTitle: Deletes UTXO/history/age files and origin data referenced only by them. No effect on registered wallets.
wallets.unrefText: Cache files from removed wallets — the UI no longer uses them.
wallets.xpubPlaceholder: Paste XPUB — zpub, xpub, ypub, vpub …
wallets.cacheDashRefreshTitle: Re-measure file sizes and coverage — no network access.
wallets.cacheDashIntro: Size and coverage of local caches — not access counts.
wallets.cacheDashDiskBlocked: Writes paused: low disk (under 5% and under 2 GiB free).
